mapper.sql: LEFT JOIN ( SELECT post_id, COUNT(*) AS commentCount FROM post_comments WHERE deleted = 0 GROUP BY post_id ) postComments ON postComments.post_id = p.id
LEFT JOIN ( SELECT target_id, COUNT(*) AS bookmarkCount FROM bookmarks WHERE target_type = 'POST' GROUP BY target_id ) postBookmarks ON postBookmarks.target_id = p.id
LEFT JOIN ( SELECT course_id, COUNT(*) AS commentCount FROM course_comments WHERE deleted = 0 GROUP BY course_id ) courseComments ON courseComments.course_id = c.id
LEFT JOIN ( SELECT target_id, COUNT(*) AS bookmarkCount FROM bookmarks WHERE target_type = 'COURSE' GROUP BY target_id ) courseBookmarks ON courseBookmarks.target_id = c.id

sql.if: AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM country_categories country WHERE country.id = c.country_id AND country.is_visible = 1 AND country.parent_id IS NULL AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM country_categories country_child WHERE country_child.parent_id = country.id AND country_child.code LIKE CONCAT(country.code, '-%') ) )

mapper.sql:
SELECT c.id, c.user_id AS userId, 'course' AS boardType, NULL AS postType, c.title, c.views, c.created_at AS createdAt, u.nickname, , COALESCE(courseComments.commentCount, 0) AS commentCount, COALESCE(courseBookmarks.bookmarkCount, 0) AS bookmarkCount FROM courses c JOIN users u ON u.id = c.user_id
WHERE c.deleted = 0 AND c.status = 'PUBLISHED'

choose.when: ORDER BY board.createdAt ASC, board.boardType ASC, board.id ASC
ORDER BY board.views DESC, board.createdAt DESC, board.boardType ASC, board.id DESC
ORDER BY board.commentCount DESC, board.createdAt DESC, board.boardType ASC, board.id DESC
ORDER BY board.bookmarkCount DESC, board.createdAt DESC, board.boardType ASC, board.id DESC
choose.otherwise: ORDER BY board.createdAt DESC, board.boardType ASC, board.id DESC

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM user_posts p WHERE p.deleted = 0
AND p.post_type = #{postType}

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM courses c WHERE c.deleted = 0 AND c.status = 'PUBLISHED'
AND 1 = 0
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM user_posts p WHERE p.deleted = 0 AND p.post_type = #{postType}
choose.otherwise: SELECT (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM user_posts p WHERE p.deleted = 0) + (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM courses c WHERE c.deleted = 0 AND c.status = 'PUBLISHED')

mapper.sql: SELECT p.id, p.user_id AS userId, 'post' AS boardType, p.post_type AS postType, NULL AS countryId, p.title, p.views, p.created_at AS createdAt, u.nickname, , ( SELECT COUNT(*) FROM post_comments pc WHERE pc.post_id = p.id AND pc.deleted = 0 ) AS commentCount FROM user_posts p JOIN users u ON p.user_id = u.id

SELECT c.id, c.user_id AS userId, 'course' AS boardType, NULL AS postType, c.country_id AS countryId, c.title, c.views, c.created_at AS createdAt, u.nickname, , ( SELECT COUNT(*) FROM course_comments cc WHERE cc.course_id = c.id AND cc.deleted = 0 ) AS commentCount FROM courses c JOIN users u ON c.user_id = u.id

WHERE p.user_id = #{userId} AND p.post_type IN ('QUESTION', 'TIP') AND p.deleted = 0 AND p.deleted_at IS NULL
UNION ALL
WHERE c.user_id = #{userId} AND c.deleted = 0 AND c.deleted_at IS NULL
AND c.status = 'PUBLISHED'
